name: Auto Lift Parts, LLC
old_description: FREE Ground Shipping (carrier of our choice) for all listed products on our website.
about:
Auto Lift Parts, LLC operates from Plano, Illinois, as an owner-operated, family-focused business. The company's owner-operators bring more than 60 years of combined experience in the auto lift parts industry, though a specific founding year is not publicly disclosed.

The firm supplies both OEM and aftermarket replacement parts for surface-mount and in-ground automotive lifts. Its catalog spans cables, power units, hydraulic cylinders, seal kits, height extensions, truck adapters, and carriage components. Orders placed by 3 p.m. CST Monday through Friday ship the same day via ground service from multiple nationwide locations, supported by a dedicated staff with deep product knowledge.

Customers include independent repair shops, dealership service departments, and any facility that relies on automotive lifts. The company stocks parts for major brands such as Rotary Lift, BendPak, Dannmar, Eagle, Gemini, Team Lift, Wheeltronic, Snap-on, Ammco, John Bean, Accuturn, Benwil, and Forward Lift, and also assists in identifying obscure or discontinued lift models to locate hard-to-find components.

Auto Lift Parts distinguishes itself by putting owner-operators directly on the phone to provide expert guidance, offering same-day shipping on in-stock items, and leveraging a multi-location fulfillment network to minimize downtime for shops awaiting critical lift repairs.
